subject.title: fix(ci): catch script declaration drift before merge

question: Should OpenClaw make this new script declaration verifier a blocking shared CI/preflight guard for all selected script, tooling, and root-test changes?
rationale: The patch is a valid preventative direction, but its fail-closed placement changes repository-wide automation behavior and needs a human owner to accept the supported declaration-pattern boundary.

options.title: Adopt the blocking guard
options.body: Accept the demonstrated contract scope and retain the verifier in CI, aggregate checks, and changed-file checks.

options.title: Narrow the trigger scope first
options.body: Keep the verifier but limit its blocking invocation until maintainers define a smaller supported script surface.

options.title: Pause the guard proposal
options.body: Defer this repository-wide automation policy and continue handling declaration drift with targeted repairs.

recommendation.title: Adopt the blocking guard
recommendation.body: Accept the demonstrated contract scope and retain the verifier in CI, aggregate checks, and changed-file checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this contributor to the recent concrete declaration repairs and the proposed generalized implementation.
